versions.changelog: DB file now created with mode 600 (owner-read/write only). System Access section updated with permission guidance.
Add System Access section to SKILL.md: explicitly documents all imports (stdlib only), no network calls, no subprocess, writes only to SQLite DB.
Initial release — shared SQLite context store for multi-session OpenClaw coordination. Three primitives: facts (key/value+TTL), alerts (cross-session queue), task deduplication.
